biggest_catch: Your friend must complete qualifying activity within 60 days and both accounts must be open and in good standing at payout - otherwise you get nothing.
catches: Referrer: existing OnPoint Community Credit Union member who refers a friend or business associate.
Referrer earns a $50 bonus per qualifying referral; 'Bonus of $50 will be credited to the accounts of you and the friend who referred you approximately 60 days after new account is opened.'
Consumer referral: friend opens a new Member Savings account with a personal checking account and receives direct deposit of at least $100 within 60 days of the open date.
Business referral: friend opens a new Business Savings account with a business checking account and receives $250 in deposits within 60 days of the open date.
Accounts must be open and in good standing at time of payout; bonus included on a 1099-INT for tax purposes.
Limit one Member Savings account per person/TIN; cannot be combined with other offers for opening a new membership.
No stated cap on number of referral bonuses; program subject to change without notice.
